{"id":"project:kmp:decision:catalog-after-assets","kind":"decision","text":"A release tags the reviewed candidate, waits until the GitHub release and all twenty-two checksummed assets are public, and only then advances the protected marketplace branch to that commit.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101788091200:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101788091200:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":6},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:release","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":6}],"metadata":{"document":"crates/kmp-release/src/application/use_cases/run_release_publication.rs (#446)","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:constraint:setup-never-writes-memory","kind":"constraint","text":"Setup and update install the plugin tree and the checksummed engine. {"id":"project:kmp:decision:guide-through-explicit-sync","kind":"decision","text":"A fresh store receives the installed guides only through the explicit kmp-guide workflow (`/kmp:guide` in Claude Code); until then a guide read returns GUIDE_UNAVAILABLE with the command to type.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787918400:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787918400:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":8},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:agent-surface","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":8}],"metadata":{"document":"plugins/kmp/README.md v0.25.0, section 'Initialize the selected store'","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:observation:tools-list-dominated-journeys","kind":"observation","text":"Measured on v0.20.0, tools/list was 80 to 97 percent of the reference tokens of every agent journey.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101790251200:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101790251200:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":9},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:agent-surface","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":9}],"metadata":{"document":"GitHub issue #850","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:decision:parameter-prose-served-by-guide","kind":"decision","text":"tools/list carries no parameter descriptions. Each tool keeps a one-line description naming its kmp_guide topic, and that topic's card returns the parameter descriptions as card.parameters. A session starts with 12,649 reference tokens instead of 24,426.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101790596800:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101790596800:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":10},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:agent-surface","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":10}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0, Changed (#850)","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:decision:saved-selection-beat-project-discovery","kind":"decision","text":"A saved memory_store selection applied to the whole machine and beat project discovery, so one saved value decided the store for every repository.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101788609600:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101788609600:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":11},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:storage","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":11}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0, Changed (#903), describing the behavior before 0.25.0","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:observation:saved-selection-captured-every-repository","kind":"observation","text":"A saved selection sent every repository on the machine to the one store it named, so project memory landed in a store nobody chose for that project.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101791028800:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101791028800:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":12},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:storage","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":12}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0, Changed (#903)","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:decision:store-selection-order","kind":"decision","text":"Store selection runs KMP_MCP_DATA_DIR, then the nearest project, then the saved selection, then the per-user default. A saved selection applies only where no project is found, and a git worktree opens its main checkout's store.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101791115200:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101791115200:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":13},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:storage","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":13}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0, Changed (#903)","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:observation:crates-publish-index-race","kind":"observation","text":"The v0.25.0 crate publication failed: `cargo publish -p kmp-mcp` could not resolve kmp-domain 0.25.0 from the crates.io index two minutes after that crate was published, so crates.io stayed at 0.24.0 and the MCP Registry publication waited for a package that never came.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101791138600:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101791138600:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":14},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:release","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":14}],"metadata":{"document":"GitHub Actions run 37224430411, job publish-crates","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:decision:wait-for-index-before-dependents","kind":"decision","text":"The crate publish chain waits until each published version is visible in the crates.io index before publishing its dependents, the publication can be resumed by an explicit dispatch, and a storefront check reports where GitHub, crates.io, the MCP Registry and the marketplace branch disagree.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101791288000:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101791288000:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":15},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:release","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":15}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, Unreleased","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:decision:guide-seeded-on-first-read","kind":"decision","text":"A guide read on a store that has no guide seeds it from the installed assets that match the binary — the launcher's KMP_PLUGIN_ROOT, the bundled engine's plugin or the host plugin cache for this version — and reads again. The explicit sync remains for shared kernels and repair.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101791288000:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101791288000:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":16},{"dimension":"area","scope_id":"label:v1:project%3Akmp:area:agent-surface","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:174542219","sequence":16}],"metadata":{"document":"CHANGELOG.md, Unreleased","source":"repository"}}

{"id":"project:kmp:constraint:no-benchmark-numbers-in-readme","kind":"constraint","text":"Benchmark numbers are not pasted into the README.
